name: hr
label: HR Assistant
description: Amazon Connect's Agentic CX designer as the orchestrator, over the Profile, Pay and Travel sub-agents and the HR tools.

connectChat.errorPrefix: [flow] The Agentic CX block returned an error

lines.tooLong: That message is too long for the HR assistant: keep it under 1,024 characters, or split it into two messages.
lines.noReply: No answer came back from the HR assistant. Try again in a moment.
lines.restarted: (The assistant started a new conversation, so it may ask for details again.)
lines.signin: HR could not confirm the sign-in. Try again in a minute.
lines.ended: The conversation ended. A new message here starts a new one.
lines.escalated: The HR service desk queue has this conversation now. A new message here starts over with the assistant.
lines.error: The HR assistant ran into an error and ended this conversation. A new message here starts a new one.
